about.title: About Me
about.content:
I work at the intersection of organizational sensemaking and technology. My background in IT architecture gives me the pragmatic tools to make complex systems tangible — but my real focus lies in helping organizations sense their environment and respond adaptively.

Drawing on Cynefin's methods and the practice of Estuary Mapping, I help leadership teams design governance systems that integrate human insights, data, and context — enriching KPIs with the capacity to learn rather than merely measure. My approach combines reflective inquiry with actionable structure, enabling organizations to move from analysis paralysis to wise, grounded action.
